title.zh: CLARITY Act chances sink below 20% as Senate’s path to 60 votes narrows
title.en: CLARITY Act chances sink below 20% as Senate’s path to 60 votes narrows

current_state.zh: The CLARITY Act's chances of enactment fell below 20% on Polymarket as Republican leaders struggle to secure the 60 Senate votes needed to advance the crypto market-structure bill, with ethics restrictions on officials' crypto interests remaining a key obstacle.
